mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities for yield.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction signaled by UNRATE exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window indicates deteriorating economic conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment that produces negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity exposure and generate negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline in the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals monetary tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million) signals strong economic activity, increasing corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals labor market recovery, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, declining FEDFUNDS (< 0.20%) combined with rising CPI (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals inflation control, reducing equity risk premiums and producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.20% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
